mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope(organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND scope_type='ORGANIZATION' AND active=TRUE UNION SELECT c.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit c JOIN visible_scope p ON c.parent_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.include_descendants=TRUE ), metrics AS ( SELECT 'REQUEST' category, r.request_status status, count(*) count FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE r.created_at>=#{from} AND r.created_at<(#{to}::date+1) GROUP BY r.request_status UNION ALL SELECT 'RESPONSE', res.response_status, count(*) FROM seal.consent_response res JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE res.submitted_at>=#{from} AND res.submitted_at<(#{to}::date+1) GROUP BY res.response_status UNION ALL SELECT 'RESPONSE_WARNING', 'WITHDRAWN', count(*) FROM seal.consent_withdrawal w JOIN seal.consent_response res USING(consent_response_id) JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE w.withdrawn_at>=#{from} AND w.withdrawn_at<(#{to}::date+1) UNION ALL SELECT 'MAIL', m.mail_status, count(*) FROM seal.mail_outbox m JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE m.created_at>=#{from} AND m.created_at<(#{to}::date+1) GROUP BY m.mail_status UNION ALL SELECT 'EVIDENCE', e.generation_status, count(*) FROM seal.evidence_package e JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE e.queued_at>=#{from} AND e.queued_at<(#{to}::date+1) GROUP BY e.generation_status UNION ALL SELECT 'EVIDENCE_WARNING', 'VERIFY_' || v.verification_result, count(*) FROM seal.evidence_verification v JOIN seal.evidence_package e USING(evidence_package_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE v.verification_result<>'VALID' AND v.verified_at>=#{from} AND v.verified_at<(#{to}::date+1) GROUP BY v.verification_result UNION ALL SELECT 'RIGHTS', rr.rights_type || ':' || rr.request_status, count(*) FROM seal.rights_request rr JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE rr.created_at>=#{from} AND rr.created_at<(#{to}::date+1) GROUP BY rr.rights_type, rr.request_status UNION ALL SELECT 'RIGHTS_WARNING', 'OVERDUE', count(*) FROM seal.rights_request rr JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE rr.due_date<CURRENT_DATE AND rr.request_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') AND rr.created_at>=#{from} AND rr.created_at<(#{to}::date+1) UNION ALL SELECT 'RETENTION', j.job_status, count(*) FROM seal.retention_job j JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE j.requested_at>=#{from} AND j.requested_at<(#{to}::date+1) GROUP BY j.job_status UNION ALL SELECT 'RETENTION_WARNING', 'LEGAL_HOLD_ACTIVE', count(*) FROM seal.legal_hold h JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE h.active AND (h.expires_on IS NULL OR h.expires_on>=CURRENT_DATE) AND h.held_at>=#{from} AND h.held_at<(#{to}::date+1) ) SELECT category, status, count FROM metrics WHERE count>0 ORDER BY category, status
